'use strict';

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { createHash, randomUUID } = require('node:crypto');
const { performance } = require('node:perf_hooks');
function monotonicEpoch() { const epoch = Date.now(), start = performance.now(); return () => Math.floor(epoch + performance.now() - start); }

const TERMINAL = new Set(['succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired']);
const STATES = new Set(['preparing', 'processing', 'queued', 'running', 'sending', 'needs_reconciliation', ...TERMINAL]);
const terminal = state => TERMINAL.has(state);
const copy = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
const fail = (code, message) => { throw Object.assign(new Error(message), { code }); };
const identifier = value => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0 && value.length <= 256;
const integer = value => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;

// Only JSON data crosses this boundary; canonicalize every immutable input field.
function canonical(value, ancestors = new Set()) {
  if (value === null || typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean') return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return JSON.stringify(value);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || ancestors.has(value) ||
      (!Array.isArray(value) && ![Object.prototype, null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(value)))) {
    fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Use finite JSON values without cycles or live objects');
  }
  ancestors.add(value);
  const result = Array.isArray(value)
    ? '[' + Array.from(value, item => canonical(item, ancestors)).join(',') + ']'
    : '{' + Object.keys(value).sort().map(key => JSON.stringify(key) + ':' + canonical(value[key], ancestors)).join(',') + '}';
  ancestors.delete(value);
  return result;
}

class QueueState {
  // The broker exclusively owns this directory. No cross-process lock or timers.
  constructor(dir, { maxQueued = 1000, maxPerClient = 100, idleMs = 60000, leaseMs = 600000, now = monotonicEpoch() } = {}) {
    for (const value of [maxQueued, maxPerClient, idleMs, leaseMs]) {
      if (!integer(value) || value === 0) fail('INVALID_OPTIONS', 'Limits and lease durations must be positive safe integers');
    }
    if (typeof now !== 'function') fail('INVALID_OPTIONS', 'now must be a clock function');
    Object.assign(this, { maxQueued, maxPerClient, idleMs, leaseMs, now });
    this.dir = path.resolve(dir);
    this.file = path.join(this.dir, 'queue-state.json');
    const created = fs.mkdirSync(this.dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    fs.chmodSync(this.dir, 0o700);
    // Persist newly created directory links, including recursive parents.
    if (created) {
      for (let current = this.dir; ; current = path.dirname(current)) {
        const parent = fs.openSync(path.dirname(current), 'r');
        try { fs.fsyncSync(parent); } finally { fs.closeSync(parent); }
        if (current === created || current === path.dirname(current)) break;
      }
    }
    this.data = { version: 1, paused: false, revision: 0, epoch: 0, blocked: null, active: null, lease: null, jobs: {}, lastClient: null };
    let saved = null;
    try {
      const fd = fs.openSync(this.file, fs.constants.O_RDONLY | fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
      try {
        fs.fchmodSync(fd, 0o600);
        saved = fs.readFileSync(fd, 'utf8');
        this.data = JSON.parse(saved);
      } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') fail('CORRUPT_STATE', `Cannot restore queue snapshot: ${error.message}`);
    }
    const d = this.data;
    if (!d || d.version !== 1 || typeof d.paused !== 'boolean' || !integer(d.revision) || !integer(d.epoch) ||
        !d.jobs || typeof d.jobs !== 'object' || Array.isArray(d.jobs) ||
        (d.active !== null && !identifier(d.active)) || (d.lastClient !== null && !identifier(d.lastClient))) {
      fail('CORRUPT_STATE', 'Unsupported queue snapshot');
    }
    const jobs = Object.values(d.jobs);
    if (jobs.some(j => !j || !identifier(j.id) || d.jobs[j.id] !== j || !STATES.has(j.state) ||
        !j.request || !identifier(j.clientId) || !integer(j.order) || !identifier(j.requestId) ||
        j.request.requestId !== j.requestId || j.request.clientId !== j.clientId ||
        !identifier(j.hash))) fail('CORRUPT_STATE', 'Invalid persisted job');
    if (d.lease && (!identifier(d.lease.id) || !identifier(d.lease.clientId) || d.lease.epoch !== d.epoch ||
        ![d.lease.createdAt, d.lease.idleUntil, d.lease.holdUntil].every(integer))) {
      fail('CORRUPT_STATE', 'Invalid sequence lease');
    }
    const uncertain = jobs.filter(j => ['running', 'sending', 'needs_reconciliation'].includes(j.state));
    if (uncertain.length > 1 || (d.active && !uncertain.some(j => j.id === d.active)) ||
        (d.blocked && !uncertain.some(j => j.id === d.blocked.id))) fail('CORRUPT_STATE', 'Inconsistent active job; recovery required');
    if (uncertain.length) {
      const job = uncertain[0];
      job.state = 'needs_reconciliation';
      job.sequenceState = job.sequenceId ? 'needs_reconciliation' : null;
      d.active = job.id;
      d.blocked = d.blocked || { id: job.id, reason: 'Broker restarted with an unfinished job', at: this._time() };
    }
    for (const job of jobs) {
      if (job.request.phased && job.id !== d.localUnknown?.id && ['preparing', 'processing', 'queued'].includes(job.state)) {
        Object.assign(job, { state: 'failed', code: 'LOCAL_WORKER_INTERRUPTED', finishedAt: this._time(),
          sequenceState: job.sequenceId ? 'ended' : null });
        if (d.lease?.clientId === job.clientId) d.lease = null;
      }
    }
    this._promoteLocalUnknown(d);
    this._serialized = saved;
    this._commit(() => null);
  }

  _time() {
    const value = this.now();
    if (!integer(value)) fail('INVALID_CLOCK', 'now() must return nonnegative integer milliseconds');
    return value;
  }

  _commit(change) {
    if (this._fault) fail('STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'A durable write failed; reopen and reconcile this queue before continuing');
    if (this._writing) fail('WRITE_IN_PROGRESS', 'QueueState writes cannot be reentered');
    this._writing = true;
    try {
      const draft = copy(this.data);
      const result = change(draft);
      const text = JSON.stringify(draft);
      if (text !== this._serialized) {
        const temp = path.join(this.dir, `.queue-state.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
        try {
          const fd = fs.openSync(temp, 'wx', 0o600);
          try { fs.writeFileSync(fd, text); fs.fsyncSync(fd); } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
          fs.renameSync(temp, this.file);
          const directory = fs.openSync(this.dir, 'r');
          try { fs.fsyncSync(directory); } finally { fs.closeSync(directory); }
        } catch (error) {
          this._fault = error;
          try { fs.unlinkSync(temp); } catch (cleanup) { if (cleanup.code !== 'ENOENT') this._cleanupError = cleanup; }
          fail('STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', `Durability is uncertain; reopen and reconcile: ${error.message}`);
        }
        this._serialized = text;
      }
      this.data = draft;
      // Rebuild only after a real transaction. Idle scheduling must never copy
      // or scan the retained terminal history on every broker timer tick.
      this._waiting = Object.values(draft.jobs).filter(job => job.state === 'queued');
      return copy(result);
    } finally { this._writing = false; }
  }

  _job(d, id) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(d.jobs, id)) fail('JOB_NOT_FOUND', 'Unknown job id');
    return d.jobs[id];
  }

  _active(d, id, recovering = false) {
    const job = this._job(d, id);
    if (terminal(job.state) || d.active !== id) fail('NOT_ACTIVE', 'Only the active, unfinished job can be updated');
    if (d.blocked && !recovering) fail('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', 'Resolve the blocked active job using proven recovery evidence');
    return job;
  }

  _promoteLocalUnknown(d) {
    if (!d.localUnknown || d.active || d.blocked) return;
    const record = d.localUnknown, job = this._job(d, record.id);
    job.state = 'needs_reconciliation'; job.sequenceState = job.sequenceId ? 'needs_reconciliation' : null;
    d.active = job.id; d.blocked = record; delete d.localUnknown;
  }

  blockLocal(id, reason) {
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._job(d, id);
      if (!job.request.phased || terminal(job.state)) fail('INVALID_STATE', 'Only an unfinished phased command can remain unknown');
      if (d.localUnknown && d.localUnknown.id !== id) fail('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', 'Another workflow already awaits reconciliation');
      d.localUnknown = { id, reason, at: this._time() };
      this._promoteLocalUnknown(d);
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  // Public views are allowlists: requests, tokens, hashes and opaque worker details stay private.
  _public(job) {
    const result = {};
    for (const key of ['id', 'requestId', 'clientId', 'description', 'kind', 'state', 'order', 'submittedAt', 'queueDeadline',
      'startedAt', 'finishedAt', 'timeoutMs', 'runDeadline', 'code', 'sequenceId', 'sequenceState', 'revision', 'contextRefreshRequired', 'physicalTurns', 'sdkRemainingMs', 'sdkReadyAt']) {
      if (job[key] !== undefined) result[key] = job[key];
    }
    if (job.sequenceMode) result.sequenceMode = job.sequenceMode;
    if (job.dispatch) result.dispatch = {
      dispatchCount: job.dispatch.dispatchCount, rpcCount: job.dispatch.rpcCount,
      completedCount: job.dispatch.completedCount, updatedAt: job.dispatch.updatedAt
    };
    for (const key of ['executionOutcome', 'userScriptSubmitted', 'mayHaveMutated', 'preflightCompleted']) {
      if (['string', 'boolean'].includes(typeof job.details?.[key])) result[key] = job.details[key];
    }
    return result;
  }

  _matches(d, request, time) {
    const lease = d.lease;
    return !!(lease && request.sequence.id === lease.id && request.clientId === lease.clientId &&
      (request.ownerToken ?? null) === lease.ownerToken && lease.epoch === d.epoch &&
      (d.active || ((d.paused ? d.pauseStartedAt ?? time : time) < lease.idleUntil && (d.paused ? d.pauseStartedAt ?? time : time) < lease.holdUntil)));
  }

  _sequenceHead(d, id) {
    let head;
    for (const job of Object.values(d.jobs)) {
      if (job.sequenceId === id && (!head || job.order > head.order)) head = job;
    }
    return head;
  }

  _automaticMatches(d, job, time) {
    const parent = d.jobs[job.sequenceParentId];
    return !!(parent && parent.sequenceMode === 'automatic' && parent.sequenceState === 'yielded' &&
      parent.state === 'succeeded' && parent.sequenceId === job.sequenceId && parent.clientId === job.clientId &&
      (parent.request.ownerToken ?? null) === (job.request.ownerToken ?? null) && (this.data.paused ? this.data.pauseStartedAt ?? time : time) < parent.finishedAt + (parent.sequencePauseMs || 0) + this.leaseMs);
  }

  _expire(d, time) {
    if (d.paused) return;
    if (d.lease && !d.active && !d.blocked && (time >= d.lease.idleUntil || time >= d.lease.holdUntil)) d.lease = null;
    for (const job of Object.values(d.jobs)) {
      if (job.state !== 'queued') continue;
      const r = job.request;
      const code = job.contextEnded ? 'SEQUENCE_EXPIRED' : job.queueDeadline !== null && time >= job.queueDeadline ? 'QUEUE_EXPIRED'
        : !job.physicalTurns && r.expectedRevision !== undefined && r.expectedRevision !== d.revision ? 'STALE_REVISION'
          : !(r.phased && job.physicalTurns && job.sequenceMode === 'automatic') && r.sequence && r.sequence.action !== 'begin' && !(job.sequenceMode === 'automatic'
            ? this._automaticMatches(d, job, time) : this._matches(d, r, time)) ? 'SEQUENCE_EXPIRED' : null;
      if (code) Object.assign(job, { state: code === 'QUEUE_EXPIRED' ? 'expired' : 'failed', code,
        finishedAt: time, revision: d.revision, sequenceState: job.sequenceId ? 'ended' : null,
        details: { executionOutcome: job.physicalTurns ? 'previous_turns_complete_current_not_started' : 'not_started',
          userScriptSubmitted: !!job.dispatch?.rpcCount, mayHaveMutated: !!job.dispatch?.rpcCount } });
    }
  }

  submit(request) {
    const text = canonical(request);
    const r = JSON.parse(text);
    if (!r || !identifier(r.requestId) || !identifier(r.clientId) || !['command', 'rpc'].includes(r.kind)) {
      fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'requestId, clientId and kind (command or rpc) are required');
    }
    if (r.description !== undefined) r.description = require('./invocation').description(r.description);
    if (!integer(r.timeoutMs) || r.timeoutMs === 0 || (r.queueTimeoutMs !== undefined && !integer(r.queueTimeoutMs)) ||
        (r.expectedRevision !== undefined && !integer(r.expectedRevision)) ||
        (r.ownerToken !== undefined && !identifier(r.ownerToken))) fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Invalid timeout, revision or owner token');
    if (r.kind === 'command' && (!Array.isArray(r.argv) || !r.argv.length ||
        r.argv.some(arg => typeof arg !== 'string') || typeof r.cwd !== 'string' || !r.cwd.trim())) fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Commands require argv and cwd');
    if (r.kind === 'rpc' && (!r.payload || typeof r.payload !== 'object' || Array.isArray(r.payload))) {
      fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'RPC jobs require a JSON object payload');
    }
    if (r.phased !== undefined && (r.phased !== true || r.kind !== 'command')) fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Only command jobs support phased execution');
    const seq = r.sequence;
    if (seq !== undefined && (!seq || !['begin', 'continue', 'end'].includes(seq.action) ||
        (seq.action === 'begin' ? seq.id !== undefined : !identifier(seq.id)) ||
        seq.mode !== undefined && !['automatic', 'exclusive'].includes(seq.mode))) fail('INVALID_SEQUENCE', 'Begin without id, or continue/end with an id; mode is automatic or exclusive');
    const identity = { ...r }; delete identity.description;
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(canonical(identity)).digest('hex');
    const existing = Object.values(this.data.jobs).find(job => job.requestId === r.requestId);
    if (existing) {
      if (existing.hash !== hash) fail('REQUEST_CONFLICT', 'requestId already exists with different immutable input');
      return this.status(existing.id);
    }
    // Expiry is its own transaction so rejected submissions cannot undo maintenance.
    this._commit(d => { this._expire(d, this._time()); return null; });
    return this._commit(d => {
      const time = this._time();
      if (r.expectedRevision !== undefined && r.expectedRevision !== d.revision) fail('STALE_REVISION', 'Read status and submit a new requestId with the current revision');
      let sequenceMode = seq?.mode || 'automatic', sequenceParent;
      if (seq && seq.action !== 'begin') {
        if (Object.values(d.jobs).some(j => !terminal(j.state) && j.sequenceId === seq.id)) {
          fail('SEQUENCE_BUSY', 'Wait for the outstanding sequence job before submitting its continuation');
        }
        sequenceParent = this._sequenceHead(d, seq.id);
        sequenceMode = sequenceParent?.sequenceMode || 'exclusive';
        if (seq.mode && seq.mode !== sequenceMode) fail('SEQUENCE_MISMATCH', 'Cannot change sequence mode');
        const automatic = sequenceMode === 'automatic';
        if (!(automatic ? this._automaticMatches(d, { sequenceParentId: sequenceParent?.id, sequenceId: seq.id,
          clientId: r.clientId, request: r }, time) : this._matches(d, r, time))) {
          fail('SEQUENCE_MISMATCH', 'Sequence expired, ended or belongs to another client/owner');
        }
      } else if (seq && d.lease && d.lease.clientId === r.clientId) fail('SEQUENCE_MISMATCH', 'Release or finish the held sequence before beginning another');
      const queued = Object.values(d.jobs).filter(job => ['preparing', 'processing', 'queued'].includes(job.state));
      if (queued.length >= this.maxQueued) fail('QUEUE_FULL', 'Global queue limit reached');
      if (queued.filter(job => job.clientId === r.clientId).length >= this.maxPerClient) fail('CLIENT_QUEUE_FULL', 'Client queue limit reached');
      const job = { id: randomUUID(), requestId: r.requestId, clientId: r.clientId, kind: r.kind,
        request: r, hash, order: Math.max(0, ...Object.values(d.jobs).map(j => j.order)) + 1, state: r.phased ? 'preparing' : 'queued', submittedAt: time,
        queueDeadline: r.phased || r.queueTimeoutMs === undefined ? null : time + r.queueTimeoutMs, timeoutMs: r.timeoutMs,
        sequenceId: seq && seq.action !== 'begin' ? seq.id : null, sequenceState: seq ? 'queued' : null };
      if (r.description) job.description = r.description;
      if (seq) job.sequenceMode = sequenceMode;
      if (sequenceParent && sequenceMode === 'automatic') {
        job.sequenceParentId = sequenceParent.id;
      }
      d.jobs[job.id] = job;
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  next() {
    if (this._fault) fail('STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'A durable write failed; reopen and reconcile this queue before continuing');
    if (this._writing) fail('WRITE_IN_PROGRESS', 'QueueState writes cannot be reentered');
    const d = this.data, time = this._time();
    if (d.paused || d.controlBlocked || d.localUnknown) return null;
    const leaseDue = d.lease && !d.active && !d.blocked && (time >= d.lease.idleUntil || time >= d.lease.holdUntil);
    const canGrant = !d.blocked && !d.paused && !d.active;
    const workDue = this._waiting.some(job => {
      const r = job.request;
      return job.queueDeadline !== null && time >= job.queueDeadline ||
        !job.physicalTurns && r.expectedRevision !== undefined && r.expectedRevision !== d.revision ||
        !(r.phased && job.physicalTurns && job.sequenceMode === 'automatic') && r.sequence && r.sequence.action !== 'begin' && !(job.sequenceMode === 'automatic'
          ? this._automaticMatches(d, job, time) : this._matches(d, r, time)) ||
        canGrant && (!d.lease || r.sequence && r.sequence.action !== 'begin' && this._matches(d, r, time) ||
          r.phased && job.physicalTurns && d.lease?.id === job.sequenceId && d.lease.clientId === job.clientId);
    });
    if (!leaseDue && !workDue) return null;
    return this._commit(d => {
      const time = this._time();
      this._expire(d, time);
      if (d.blocked || d.paused || d.active) return null;
      const eligible = Object.values(d.jobs).filter(j => j.state === 'queued' && (!d.lease ||
        (j.request.sequence && j.request.sequence.action !== 'begin' && this._matches(d, j.request, time)) ||
        (j.request.phased && j.physicalTurns && d.lease?.id === j.sequenceId && d.lease.clientId === j.clientId)));
      const clients = [...new Set(eligible.map(j => j.clientId))].sort();
      if (!clients.length) return null;
      const client = clients.find(id => d.lastClient === null || id > d.lastClient) || clients[0];
      const job = eligible.filter(j => j.clientId === client).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)[0];
      const r = job.request;
      if (r.sequence && r.sequence.action === 'begin' && !job.sequenceId) {
        job.sequenceId = randomUUID();
        if (job.sequenceMode !== 'automatic') {
          d.lease = { id: job.sequenceId, clientId: client, ownerToken: r.ownerToken ?? null, epoch: ++d.epoch,
            createdAt: time, idleUntil: time + Math.min(this.idleMs, this.leaseMs), holdUntil: time + this.leaseMs };
        }
      }
      Object.assign(job, { state: 'running', startedAt: job.startedAt ?? time, runDeadline: time + (job.sdkRemainingMs ?? job.timeoutMs),
        sequenceState: job.sequenceId ? 'active' : null, revision: d.revision });
      d.active = job.id;
      d.lastClient = client;
      return job; // Detached INTERNAL job, including request, only after durable commit.
    });
  }

  readyTurn(id) {
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._job(d, id);
      if (!job.request.phased || !['preparing', 'processing'].includes(job.state)) fail('INVALID_STATE', 'Worker is not preparing an SDK turn');
      if (job.contextEnded) fail('SEQUENCE_EXPIRED', 'The owner ended this command context before another SDK turn');
      if (job.sdkRemainingMs === 0) fail('RUN_TIMEOUT', 'The command has exhausted its SDK execution budget');
      const time = this._time();
      Object.assign(job, { state: 'queued', order: Math.max(0, ...Object.values(d.jobs).map(j => j.order)) + 1,
        sdkReadyAt: time,
        queueDeadline: job.request.queueTimeoutMs === undefined ? null : time + job.request.queueTimeoutMs });
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  releaseTurn(id, sdkRemainingMs) {
    if (!integer(sdkRemainingMs)) fail('INVALID_TIMEOUT', 'SDK remaining budget must be nonnegative');
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._active(d, id);
      if (!job.request.phased) fail('INVALID_STATE', 'Not a phased command');
      Object.assign(job, { state: 'processing', sdkRemainingMs, physicalTurns: (job.physicalTurns || 0) + 1,
        revision: ++d.revision, sequenceState: job.sequenceId ? (d.lease ? 'held' : 'yielded') : null });
      d.active = null;
      if (d.lease) d.lease.idleUntil = Math.min(this._time() + this.idleMs, d.lease.holdUntil);
      this._promoteLocalUnknown(d);
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  finishLocal(id, { state = 'succeeded', ...details } = {}) {
    if (!['succeeded', 'failed'].includes(state)) fail('INVALID_STATE', 'Finish local work with a proven terminal result');
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._job(d, id);
      if (!job.request.phased || !['preparing', 'processing', 'queued'].includes(job.state) || d.active === id) fail('NOT_LOCAL', 'SDK work is not settled');
      Object.assign(job, { state, details: copy(details), finishedAt: this._time(), revision: d.revision });
      if (details.code) job.code = details.code;
      if (d.lease?.id === job.sequenceId && (state === 'failed' || job.request.sequence?.action === 'end')) d.lease = null;
      job.sequenceState = job.sequenceId ? (state === 'succeeded' && !job.contextEnded && job.request.sequence?.action !== 'end' ? (d.lease?.id === job.sequenceId ? 'held' : 'yielded') : 'ended') : null;
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  finish(id, { state = 'succeeded', ...details } = {}) {
    if (!['succeeded', 'failed', 'needs_reconciliation'].includes(state)) fail('INVALID_STATE', 'Finish with succeeded, failed or needs_reconciliation');
    const record = JSON.parse(canonical(details));
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._active(d, id);
      const time = this._time();
      Object.assign(job, { state, details: record, revision: ++d.revision });
      if (typeof record.code === 'string') job.code = record.code;
      if (state === 'needs_reconciliation') {
        d.blocked = { id, reason: record.reason || 'Worker outcome is unknown', at: time };
        job.sequenceState = job.sequenceId ? 'needs_reconciliation' : null;
      } else {
        d.active = null;
        job.finishedAt = time;
        if (state === 'failed' || !job.request.sequence || job.request.sequence.action === 'end') d.lease = null;
        if (d.lease) {
          if (d.paused) {
            d.lease.holdUntil += Math.max(0, time - Math.max(d.pauseStartedAt ?? time, d.lease.pauseBase || d.lease.createdAt));
            d.lease.pauseBase = time;
          }
          d.lease.idleUntil = Math.min(time + this.idleMs, d.lease.holdUntil);
          if (time >= d.lease.holdUntil && !d.paused) d.lease = null;
        }
        job.sequenceState = job.sequenceId ? (job.sequenceMode === 'automatic' && state === 'succeeded' &&
          job.request.sequence.action !== 'end' ? 'yielded' : d.lease ? 'held' : 'ended') : null;
        this._promoteLocalUnknown(d);
      }
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  markDispatch(id, details = {}) {
    const record = JSON.parse(canonical(details));
    if (!record || Array.isArray(record) || typeof record !== 'object') fail('INVALID_DISPATCH', 'Dispatch details must be an object');
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._active(d, id);
      const old = job.dispatch || { dispatchCount: 0, rpcCount: 0, completedCount: 0 };
      const rpcCount = record.rpcCount ?? old.rpcCount + 1;
      const completedCount = record.completedCount ?? old.completedCount;
      if (!integer(rpcCount) || rpcCount < old.rpcCount || !integer(completedCount) ||
          completedCount < old.completedCount || completedCount > rpcCount) fail('INVALID_DISPATCH', 'RPC counters must be monotonic and completedCount <= rpcCount');
      job.dispatch = { rpcState: record.rpcState ?? record.state ?? 'sending', dispatchCount: old.dispatchCount + 1,
        rpcCount, completedCount, updatedAt: this._time(), details: record };
      job.state = 'sending';
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  advanceInstanceEpoch(transitionId) {
    if (!identifier(transitionId)) fail('INVALID_TRANSITION', 'A stable instance transition id is required');
    return this._commit(d => {
      if (d.paused) fail('MANUAL_PAUSE', 'Automatic instance recovery does not clear a manual pause');
      if (d.active || d.blocked || d.lease || Object.values(d.jobs).some(job => !terminal(job.state))) {
        fail('QUEUE_NOT_QUIESCENT', 'Automatic instance recovery requires terminal jobs and no active job, block or lease');
      }
      if (d.lastInstanceTransitionId === transitionId) return { alreadyApplied: true, revision: d.revision, epoch: d.epoch };
      const previous = { revision: d.revision, epoch: d.epoch };
      d.revision++;
      d.epoch++;
      d.lastInstanceTransitionId = transitionId;
      return { alreadyApplied: false, previous, revision: d.revision, epoch: d.epoch };
    });
  }

  block(id, reason) {
    return this.finish(id, { state: 'needs_reconciliation', reason: JSON.parse(canonical(reason)) });
  }

  resolve(id, details) {
    const record = JSON.parse(canonical(details));
    if (!record || !['succeeded', 'failed'].includes(record.state)) fail('INVALID_STATE', 'Recovery must explicitly provide state succeeded or failed');
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._active(d, id, true);
      if (!d.blocked || d.blocked.id !== id || job.state !== 'needs_reconciliation') fail('NOT_BLOCKED', 'Only the blocked active job can be resolved');
      Object.assign(job, { state: record.state, details: record, finishedAt: this._time(), revision: ++d.revision,
        sequenceState: job.sequenceId ? 'ended' : null });
      if (typeof record.code === 'string') job.code = record.code;
      d.blocked = d.active = d.lease = null;
      this._promoteLocalUnknown(d);
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  cancel(id, clientId) {
    return this._commit(d => {
      const job = this._job(d, id);
      if (job.clientId !== clientId) fail('NOT_OWNER', 'Only the submitting client can cancel this job');
      if (job.state !== 'queued') fail('NOT_QUEUED', 'Only queued jobs can be cancelled');
      if (job.physicalTurns || job.dispatch?.rpcCount) fail('ALREADY_STARTED', 'Cannot cancel a command after its first SDK turn');
      Object.assign(job, { state: 'cancelled', finishedAt: this._time(), revision: d.revision,
        code: 'CANCELLED', details: { executionOutcome: 'not_started', userScriptSubmitted: false, mayHaveMutated: false },
        sequenceState: job.sequenceId ? 'ended' : null });
      return this._public(job);
    });
  }

  release(sequenceId, clientId) {
    this._commit(d => { this._expire(d, this._time()); return null; });
    return this._commit(d => {
      if (d.active || d.blocked) fail('QUEUE_BUSY', 'Cannot release while a job is active or requires reconciliation');
      if (!d.lease || d.lease.id !== sequenceId) {
        const head = this._sequenceHead(d, sequenceId);
        if (head?.sequenceMode === 'automatic' && head.sequenceState === 'yielded') {
          if (head.clientId !== clientId) fail('NOT_OWNER', 'Only the sequence owner can release it');
          head.sequenceState = 'ended';
          for (const job of Object.values(d.jobs)) if (job.sequenceId === sequenceId && !terminal(job.state)) job.contextEnded = true;
          this._expire(d, this._time());
          return { sequenceId, sequenceState: 'released', revision: d.revision };
        }
      }
      if (!d.lease || d.lease.id !== sequenceId) fail('SEQUENCE_MISMATCH', 'Sequence is no longer held');
      if (d.lease.clientId !== clientId) fail('NOT_OWNER', 'Only the sequence owner can release it');
      d.lease = null;
      for (const job of Object.values(d.jobs)) if (job.sequenceId === sequenceId && !terminal(job.state)) {
        job.contextEnded = true; job.sequenceState = 'ended';
      }
      this._expire(d, this._time());
      return { sequenceId, sequenceState: 'released', revision: d.revision };
    });
  }

  summary() {
    if (this._fault) fail('STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Reopen and reconcile after the failed durable write');
    const d = this.data;
    const lease = d.lease && { id: d.lease.id, clientId: d.lease.clientId, epoch: d.lease.epoch,
      createdAt: d.lease.createdAt, idleUntil: d.lease.idleUntil, holdUntil: d.lease.holdUntil };
    return copy({ version: d.version, paused: d.paused, revision: d.revision, epoch: d.epoch, active: d.active,
      blocked: d.blocked && { id: d.blocked.id, code: 'NEEDS_RECONCILIATION', at: d.blocked.at }, lease,
      lastClient: d.lastClient });
  }

  status(id) {
    if (this._fault) fail('STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Reopen and reconcile after the failed durable write');
    if (id !== undefined) return copy(this._public(this._job(this.data, id)));
    return { ...this.summary(), jobs: Object.fromEntries(Object.values(this.data.jobs).map(j => [j.id, copy(this._public(j))])) };
  }

  pause(paused, requestId) {
    if (typeof paused !== 'boolean') fail('INVALID_PAUSE', 'pause expects a boolean');
    this._commit(d => {
      const time = this._time();
      if (paused !== d.paused) {
        if (paused) d.pauseStartedAt = time;
        else {
          const start = d.pauseStartedAt ?? time;
          for (const job of Object.values(d.jobs)) {
            if (['queued', 'preparing', 'processing'].includes(job.state)) {
              job.contextRefreshRequired = true;
              if (job.state === 'queued' && job.queueDeadline !== null) job.queueDeadline += Math.max(0, time - Math.max(start, job.sdkReadyAt ?? job.submittedAt));
            }
            if (job.sequenceState === 'yielded' && integer(job.finishedAt)) job.sequencePauseMs = (job.sequencePauseMs || 0) + Math.max(0, time - Math.max(start, job.finishedAt));
          }
          if (d.lease) {
            const elapsed = Math.max(0, time - Math.max(start, d.lease.pauseBase || d.lease.createdAt));
            d.lease.idleUntil += elapsed; d.lease.holdUntil += elapsed; delete d.lease.pauseBase;
          }
          d.contextEpoch = (d.contextEpoch || 0) + 1;
          delete d.pauseStartedAt;
        }
        d.paused = paused; d.controlGeneration = (d.controlGeneration || 0) + 1;
      }
      if (requestId) {
        d.controlRequests ||= {};
        Object.defineProperty(d.controlRequests, requestId, { value: { paused, generation: d.controlGeneration || 0 }, enumerable: true, configurable: true, writable: true });
        const keys = Object.keys(d.controlRequests);
        for (const key of keys.slice(0, Math.max(0, keys.length - 128))) delete d.controlRequests[key];
      }
      return null;
    });
    return this.status();
  }
}

module.exports = { QueueState, terminal };
